---
title: "Results-first supplementary workbook numbering"
format: html
---

Preserve author-edited worksheet content and styles. Only table identifiers,
sheet order and cross-references change. Original S27 remains reserved pending
the author's decision. The original Office package is not round-tripped through
a spreadsheet conversion engine.

```{python}
import json,re,zipfile,hashlib,copy,xml.etree.ElementTree as E
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/supplement_placement_audit_2026-09-23')
mapping={int(k):v for k,v in json.loads((out/'new_mapping.json').read_text())['old_to_new'].items()}
source=out/'workbook_before.xlsm'
M='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
R='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}'
z=zipfile.ZipFile(source)
wb=E.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets=wb.find(M+'sheets')
rels=E.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
targets={e.get('Id'):e.get('Target') for e in rels}
def sheetpath(s):
    p=targets[s.get(R+'id')]
    return p.lstrip('/') if p.startswith('/') else 'xl/'+p
ss=[''.join(e.itertext()) for e in E.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))]
names={s.get('name'):re.sub(r'^S(\d+)',lambda m:'S'+str(mapping[int(m[1])]),s.get('name')) for s in sheets}
def relabel(value):
    # Exact tab names and standalone S-number references only; numeric data stay intact.
    if value in names:return names[value]
    return re.sub(r'\bS(\d+)\b',lambda m:'S'+str(mapping[int(m[1])]) if int(m[1]) in mapping else m[0],value)
replacement={}; changed_cells={}; unchanged=[]
for sh in sheets:
    path=sheetpath(sh); raw=z.read(path); doc=E.fromstring(raw); edits=[]
    for cell in doc.iter(M+'c'):
        if cell.get('t')=='s':
            v=cell.find(M+'v'); val=ss[int(v.text)]
        elif cell.get('t')=='inlineStr':val=''.join(cell.find(M+'is').itertext())
        elif cell.get('t')=='str':val=(cell.find(M+'v').text or '') if cell.find(M+'v') is not None else ''
        else:continue
        if sh.get('name') not in ['Index','Column definitions'] and 'Supplementary Table' not in val and not re.search(r'\bTables? S\d+',val):continue
        new=relabel(val)
        if new!=val:
            # These identifiers are table metadata, never MAG/contig/sample IDs.
            assert sh.get('name') in ['Index','Column definitions'] or re.search(r'\bTables? S\d+',val), (sh.get('name'),cell.get('r'),val)
            for child in list(cell):cell.remove(child)
            cell.set('t','inlineStr');E.SubElement(E.SubElement(cell,M+'is'),M+'t').text=new
            edits.append({'cell':cell.get('r'),'before':val,'after':new})
    if sh.get('name')=='Index':
        data=doc.find(M+'sheetData'); rows=list(data);header=rows[0]
        def rownum(row):
            first=row.find(M+'c'); txt=''.join(first.find(M+'is').itertext()) if first.get('t')=='inlineStr' else (ss[int(first.find(M+'v').text)] if first.get('t')=='s' else first.find(M+'v').text)
            return int(re.search(r'S(\d+)',txt)[1])
        rows=[header]+sorted(rows[1:],key=rownum)
        for i,row in enumerate(rows,1):
            row.set('r',str(i))
            for c in row:c.set('r',re.sub(r'\d+$',str(i),c.get('r')))
        data[:]=rows
    if edits or sh.get('name')=='Index':
        replacement[path]=E.tostring(doc,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True);changed_cells[path]=edits
    else:unchanged.append(path)
    sh.set('name',names[sh.get('name')])
ordered=sorted([s for s in sheets if re.match(r'S\d+',s.get('name'))],key=lambda s:int(re.match(r'S(\d+)',s.get('name'))[1]))
sheets[:]=[s for s in sheets if s.get('name')=='Index']+ordered+[s for s in sheets if s.get('name')=='Column definitions']
assert len(sheets)==30
for view in wb.iter(M+'workbookView'):view.set('activeTab','0')
replacement['xl/workbook.xml']=E.tostring(wb,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
# Sheet-name references in formulas require a separate audited update, not silent changes.
for path in z.namelist():
    if path.endswith('.xml') and (path.startswith('xl/worksheets/') or path=='xl/workbook.xml'):
        tree=E.fromstring(z.read(path))
        for e in tree.iter():
            if e.tag in (M+'f',M+'definedName') and e.text:
                assert not any(name+'!' in e.text or "'"+name+"'!" in e.text for name in names if name!=names[name]),('Formula references old sheet',path,e.text)
dest=out/'Supplementary_Tables_results_order.xlsm'
with zipfile.ZipFile(dest,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as w:
    for info in z.infolist():w.writestr(copy.copy(info),replacement.get(info.filename,z.read(info.filename)))
nz=zipfile.ZipFile(dest);assert nz.testzip() is None
assert all(z.read(p)==nz.read(p) for p in z.namelist() if p not in replacement)
report={'source_md5':hashlib.md5(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'output_md5':hashlib.md5(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'changed_parts':list(replacement),'changed_text_cells':changed_cells,'unchanged_worksheet_parts':unchanged,'all_unaffected_parts_byte_identical':True,'old_to_new':mapping}
(out/'workbook_preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print('All unaffected ZIP parts byte-identical;',len(unchanged),'worksheets unchanged;',len(changed_cells),'metadata-only sheet updates')
```
